commit 7fdda9adb6eab7a0822534f740637f99d54fc3e5
Author:     Max Emig <mozilla@emigm.ax>
AuthorDate: Wed Jul 1 16:40:34 2026 +0000
Commit:     john@thunderbird.net <john@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Wed Jul 1 16:42:39 2026 +0000

    Bug 1855401 - Fix crash copying an empty srcHdrs array. r=tobyp
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D309396

diff --git a/mailnews/local/src/nsLocalMailFolder.cpp b/mailnews/local/src/nsLocalMailFolder.cpp
index c3e7ce897cc..fcad4403da9 100644
--- a/mailnews/local/src/nsLocalMailFolder.cpp
+++ b/mailnews/local/src/nsLocalMailFolder.cpp
@@ -1408,6 +1408,10 @@ nsMsgLocalMailFolder::CopyMessages(nsIMsgFolder* srcFolder,
     if (isMove) srcFolder->NotifyFolderEvent(kDeleteOrMoveMsgFailed);
     return OnCopyCompleted(srcSupport, false);
   }
+  if (srcHdrs.IsEmpty()) {
+    NS_WARNING("Cannot copy an empty message array");
+    return NS_ERROR_INVALID_ARG;
+  }
 
   // If allowUndo is true, this should be a user-initiated action.
   UpdateTimestamps(allowUndo);
diff --git a/mailnews/local/test/unit/test_emptyCopyMessages.js b/mailnews/local/test/unit/test_emptyCopyMessages.js
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..b6369b601e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mailnews/local/test/unit/test_emptyCopyMessages.js
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+/* This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
+ * License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
+ * file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/. */
+
+var { MessageInjection } = ChromeUtils.importESModule(
+  "resource://testing-common/mailnews/MessageInjection.sys.mjs"
+);
+
+const messageInjection = new MessageInjection({ mode: "local" });
+
+add_task(async function rejectEmptyCopy() {
+  const srcFolder = await messageInjection.makeEmptyFolder();
+  const dstFolder = await messageInjection.makeEmptyFolder();
+
+  Assert.throws(
+    () =>
+      dstFolder.copyMessages(srcFolder, [], false, null, null, false, false),
+    ex => ex.result == Cr.NS_ERROR_INVALID_ARG,
+    "Direct empty message copies should be rejected."
+  );
+});
diff --git a/mailnews/local/test/unit/xpcshell.toml b/mailnews/local/test/unit/xpcshell.toml
index 1a50e54501b..2c521ae533f 100644
--- a/mailnews/local/test/unit/xpcshell.toml
+++ b/mailnews/local/test/unit/xpcshell.toml
@@ -18,6 +18,8 @@ dupe-manifest = true
 ["test_duplicateKey.js"]
 tags = ["compact"]
 
+["test_emptyCopyMessages.js"]
+
 ["test_fileName.js"]
 
 ["test_folderLoaded.js"]
